scope: One complete eight-domain synthetic V6 world with actual sparse fixed sensor and paid handheld/crew/action; no actual state to dispatch.
unchanged_service_ceiling: Network capacity0.25 stays limiting; filter intervention does not restore that service bottleneck.
forecast_scope_note: Service horizon in the value catalog is relative to each decision. It is a prediction window, not the same object as the6s physical engineering capture horizon.
fixed_sensor_note: period10 phase0 latency0.5, continued polling; actual no second poll before6 is a declared schedule, not disabled sensors.
safety_identity_note: Public nominal/actual engineering colocated worker/tool bindings must be identical and explicitly labeled.
actual_failure_note: Forecast success/support assumption is not enforced on plant. Any unsuitable/indeterminate/aborted result remains genuine and can invalidate prediction.
freeze_gate: Only after online implementation review should an immutable protocol pin exact inputs/source/tools, case budget, output set and failure rule.
